title: veridict sprt report
description: JSON output of `veridict sprt`, for --sprt-variant wald (default), trinomial, and pentanomial.

schema_version.description: Stays 1 across additive changes; bumps only when a field is removed or renamed.

validity.description: Valid unless a --max-timeouts/--max-crashes/--max-invalid cap was breached, in which case verdict above is also forced to inconclusive.

promotion.description: The single go/no-go field: promoted only when validity is valid and verdict is pass.

llr.description: Accumulated log-likelihood ratio. For --sprt-variant pentanomial, this is the LLR at the sequential stopping point (see stopping_pair_count), not a naive recompute over the whole input - the two can differ whenever the true stopping point falls before the input's end.

elo0.description: H0 hypothesis gap. Logistic Elo for wald, BayesElo for trinomial - see docs/metrics.md for why these are different scales.

alpha.description: Guaranteed false-positive rate (accepting H1 when H0 is true) - not a tunable report threshold.

beta.description: Guaranteed false-negative rate (accepting H0 when H1 is true).

drawelo.description: Estimated draw-rate nuisance parameter. Some only for --sprt-variant trinomial (reported for transparency, since it's estimated from the same data being judged); null for wald/pentanomial, neither of which models a draw rate.

pentanomial_counts.description: Some only for --sprt-variant pentanomial: the 5-value breakdown the LLR was computed from (candidate_wins/baseline_wins/draws above are still populated too, netted from these same 5 buckets); null for wald/trinomial.

raw_trial_count.description: Some only for --sprt-variant pentanomial: total input records before pairing (always 2 * available_paired_count, since an incomplete pair is rejected before a report is produced).

paired_count.description: Some only for --sprt-variant pentanomial: number of complete pairs actually analyzed, i.e. folded into llr/pentanomial_counts up to the sequential stopping point. May be less than available_paired_count when the walk stopped early - see stopping_pair_count/ignored_pairs_after_stop.

available_paired_count.description: Some only for --sprt-variant pentanomial: total complete pairs present in the input, before any sequential truncation. Equal to paired_count unless the walk stopped early.

stopping_pair_count.description: Some only for --sprt-variant pentanomial, and then only if the sequential walk actually stopped (a decisive verdict or a --max-paired-ids cutoff). null means the walk consumed every available pair without either (the ordinary 'keep testing' state); in that case paired_count == available_paired_count.

ignored_pairs_after_stop.description: Some only for --sprt-variant pentanomial: available_paired_count - paired_count - pairs present in the input but never folded into the analysis because they completed after the sequential stopping point. 0 (not null) when nothing was ignored; null means this isn't a pentanomial run at all.

min_paired_ids.description: Echoes --min-paired-ids, Some only when it was passed (requires --sprt-variant pentanomial). The sequential walk never evaluates a boundary crossing before this many pairs have completed.

max_paired_ids.description: Echoes --max-paired-ids, Some only when it was passed (requires --sprt-variant pentanomial). If the walk reaches this many completed pairs without a boundary crossing, it stops there with an inconclusive verdict; pairs completed after this point never affect the verdict, llr, or bucket counts.

require_complete_pairs.description: Echoes --require-complete-pairs. For wald/trinomial with --paired-by-id, upgrades a lone id from a tolerated unpaired sample into a hard error. A no-op for pentanomial, which already enforces this unconditionally.
